compact_definition: no trio and no quartet CH (plan 5.1); bay-free species preferred among compact; n_bay = count of '1' segments in the boundary-edge code
note: plan 5.1 asks for about 18 compact / 7 irregular; the 20-30 C bin has a single compact neutral/cation pair (coronene), so its other slots are irregular, and 30-45 C needs a bay-bearing compact species (C44H18)
